name: MultiSelect
summary: Choose multiple items from a searchable popup with a compact selection summary.

useWhen: Selecting several values from a collection while keeping the field compact.
avoidWhen: For one choice, free-form tags, or a short list that can remain visible.

obligations: Items have serializable IDs, and the popup filters them by search text.
Keyboard focus stays inside the open popup until it closes on Escape.

defaults.emptyStateDescription: Please try a different search term.

behavior: Items have serializable IDs, and the selection is a set of those IDs, or all of them.
The selection can be controlled with selectedKeys or left uncontrolled, and onSelectionChange reports the new selection.
The popup filters items by the search text.
The Reset and Select all buttons only call onReset and onSelectAll; the application changes the selection, so they do nothing to an uncontrolled selection.
MultiSelect is not a native select: it renders no form input and submits nothing, so the application serializes the selected IDs.
required adds an asterisk to the label; it does not check that anything is selected.
Escape clears the selection when there is one; with nothing selected, Escape closes the popup and returns focus to the trigger.
Keyboard focus stays inside the popup while it is open.
The search field's label and placeholder and the Reset, Select all, and Clear search buttons use fixed English text.
The label, placeholder, selection summary, and empty-state text come from props.
accessibility: Items have serializable IDs, and the popup filters them by search text.
Keyboard focus stays inside the open popup until it closes on Escape.

requirements.reason: Native dynamic colors do not apply to the React web binding.
Native font metrics do not apply to the React web binding.
